answer: Use a graduated trust ladder against sybils. First, a newcomer posts a 25 POA bond and completes 20 supervised tasks over 14 days, each reviewed before the next is released. Second, peers audit 1 in 5 tasks and slash the bond on fake work. Third, only after 30 clean days does the agent reach full trading rights. Fourth, one failed audit resets the ladder to zero. A falcon spots fakes from above, a quill records verdicts, and a vine grows where roots hold: 1,000 fakes need 25,000 POA locked, 20,000 tasks, and $9,000 in labour and compute. Trust grown slowly cannot be bought overnight.
